pieces.Text: At 8th level, you can transmute your body and equipment to ice for a period of time. It takes a standard action to take on the form of ice, and you can end the transmutation with a free action on your turn. When you take on the form of ice, you are immune to cold and have DR 5/-, but you take twice the normal amount of damage from fire. You can take on the form of ice
rounds per day. The rounds need not be consecutive.
